shared_elements: row of repeated short vertical strokes forming a comb-like band
registers/rows of motifs stacked vertically on the surface
justification: Both surfaces present schematic figures arranged in stacked horizontal registers, and both include a comb-like band of short repeated vertical strokes (a fringe row in A, the crew-strokes on the boats in B), plus small stick-like human figures; but these are generic devices. A is dominated by naturalistically modelled animals in profile (quadrupeds, a long-necked bird, a snake-like zigzag) carved in relief with volumetric bodies and detailed heads, while B is dominated by an unmistakable repeated boat motif with upturned prows carrying rows of crew strokes, a motif entirely absent from A, so the correspondence is superficial rather than iconographic.
